items.title: Build source inventory for Claude Code Game Studios
items.done_when: The inventory records 73 skills, 49 agents, 12 hooks, 11 rules, template counts, source paths, and excluded paths.

items.title: Create Codex plugin scaffold
items.done_when: plugins/codex-game-studios contains .codex-plugin/plugin.json, skills, references, scripts, and assets roots with valid relative paths.

items.title: Convert Claude skills into Codex skills
items.done_when: All 73 source skills have generated Codex SKILL.md files with name and description frontmatter and no Claude-only runtime metadata.

items.title: Convert Claude agents into role references
items.done_when: All 49 source agents have role reference files and appear in the role routing index with mapped skills.

items.title: Generate repository-local Codex instructions
items.done_when: AGENTS.md contains resolved Codex instructions and no unresolved Claude @path include syntax.

items.title: Preserve validation hooks as Codex scripts
items.done_when: Hook scripts are available under scripts/hooks with documentation, and automatic hook registration is omitted until Codex hook schema verification.

items.title: Run validation matrix and reviewer smoke test
items.done_when: JSON validity, source inventory, skill frontmatter, reference reachability, Claude-only construct checks, and representative workflow smoke tests pass.
